إِبَاضٌ The cord, or rope, with which the pastern of a camel's fore leg is tied, or bound, to his arm, so that his fore leg is raised from the ground: (As, S, A, K:) pl. أُبُضٌ. (K.) The dim. is ↓ أُبَيِّضٌ . (S.) ―
-b2- A certain vein (عِرْق) in the hind leg (AO, K) of a horse. (AO.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
